Description: DeployIQ signed GitHub webhook ingestion: HTTP API, Lambda, DynamoDB

WebhookSecret.Description: Generate a random secret and enter the same value in GitHub's webhook settings. Do not commit it.

GitHubTokenSecretArn.Description: ARN of an existing Secrets Manager secret whose plaintext is a fine-grained GitHub token with Actions read access to this repository.

DashboardOrigin.Description: Exact frontend browser origin. Keep the default for local development.

ContentSecurityPolicy.ContentSecurityPolicy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src 'self' https://fonts.gstatic.com; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' https://*.execute-api.us-east-1.amazonaws.com https://cognito-idp.us-east-1.amazonaws.com; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; form-action 'self'; upgrade-insecure-requests
